title: OpenAI ChatGPT Schema
description: Execute OpenAI Chat Completions (or compatible hosts) with text or JSON responses

prompt.description: The user prompt/message to send to the AI model

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to steer the assistant's behaviour

response_format.description: Expected response format - 'text' for plain text or 'json' for structured JSON output

model.description: Chat completion model to use (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, o3-mini, etc.)

api_host.description: Override for the OpenAI-compatible API host (defaults to profile BASE_URL or https://api.openai.com/v1/)

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Higher = more creative, lower = more deterministic

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion

frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens based on how often they already appeared

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far

seed.description: Deterministic seed (where supported) for reproducible completions

response_format.description: Raw OpenAI response_format payload for fine-grained JSON control (json_object, json_schema, etc.)

response.description: Processed response (string for text mode, object for JSON mode)

usage.description: Token usage metadata direct from OpenAI

model.description: Actual model used by OpenAI for the request

parse_success.description: Indicates if JSON parsing succeeded when response_format=json

profile.description: Requires AI credentials profile with API_KEY (and optional BASE_URL pointing to an OpenAI-compatible host).
